zh.title: 发布状态
items: **0.1.0-rc.4** 是修复候选版，正式通道仍为 0.0.18，npm beta 仍为 0.1.0-beta.5。负责人全面测试、连续日用七天及明确批准后才发布 0.1.0。
保留此前候选的机器人、任务、目标、记忆、TUI、远程和诊断功能。

zh.title: 本次修复
items: 修复 RC3 把旧 Beta5 提示为新版本的问题。Beta 更新通道现在按版本号选择最高的 Alpha、Beta 或 RC；同版本及更低版本均不会提示、下载或安装。
每次切换更新通道后关闭降级，绑定所选发布标签与实际平台清单版本；清单缺失或不一致明确失败，不回退旧安装包。继续使用原有下载、SHA 校验与平台签名链。
机器人侧栏底部收为一行：SVG 账户入口在左、版本入口在最右；通道选择只在“设置 → 更新与关于”显示。窄侧栏的下载进度和安装操作保持可达。

zh.title: 升级
items: **旧 Beta5 / RC1–3 必须先从本次 Release 手动下载对应平台安装包，退出应用后安装 RC4。** 冻结旧客户端的更新器仍可能跳过 RC 或提示旧 Beta；不要同意该降级提示。安装本次修复后再使用应用内更新检查。
升级前备份完整数据根；同步升级 Desktop、CLI/TUI 和 Gateway，先退出旧宿主。机器人身份、会话、头像、目标和记忆保留；设置 → 通用 → 界面可切回经典界面。
macOS CLI 使用同次 Desktop 构建的签名凭据助手，peer 与 peer-credential-helper 放在同一目录。已发布 Beta / RC 标签和资产保持不变。

zh.title: 验证与限制
items: 完整本机回归、定向真实 SDK 测试、22 项受控升级矩阵、两平台 CI 与真实源窗口分别记录。真实 GitHub 发布元数据检查不等同安装包下载或安装；新签名包的实际检查另行记录。
复杂写任务仍发现独立核验所需的执行命令未完整进入 Evidence 快照；严格失败未被改成通过，尚未宣布总体 Ready。
Windows/Linux 交互安装、实体手机、生产 OIDC/远程部署与七天日用需要对应环境验收。未来 RC 的实际自动下载/安装尚未发生，不宣称已经通过。
远程仅文本且电脑须在线，批准留在本地；隔离写任务需要 Git，外部副作用须授权。目标 token 硬限尚未实现并拒绝配置。上传头像为静态图，默认 SVG 头像支持状态动效。

en.title: Release status
items: **0.1.0-rc.4** is a repair candidate. Stable remains 0.0.18 and npm beta remains 0.1.0-beta.5. Version 0.1.0 requires comprehensive owner testing, seven days of daily use and explicit approval.
Bots, tasks, objectives, memory, TUI, remote input and diagnostics from previous candidates remain available.

en.title: Fixes
items: Fix RC3 offering the older Beta5 as a new version. The Beta update channel now selects the highest Alpha, Beta or RC by version. Equal and older versions cannot be offered, downloaded or installed.

Disable downgrades after every channel change and bind the selected release tag to its platform manifest. Missing or mismatched manifests fail explicitly instead of falling back to older packages. Existing downloads, SHA checks and platform signature verification remain in use.

Compact the bot sidebar footer into one row: an SVG account entrance on the left and version on the far right. Channel selection appears only in Settings → Update & About. Download progress and installation controls remain reachable in narrow sidebars.

en.title: Upgrade
items: **Older Beta5 / RC1–3 clients must first download the installer for their platform from this Release, quit the application and install RC4 manually.** Their immutable updaters may still skip RC tags or offer an older Beta. Decline the downgrade prompt. Use in-app update checks after installing this fix.

Back up the complete data root and upgrade Desktop, CLI/TUI and Gateway together after quitting older hosts. Bot identities, conversations, avatars, objectives and memory remain. Settings → General → Interface can restore classic chat.
macOS CLI uses the signed credential helper from the same Desktop build. Keep peer and peer-credential-helper in the same directory. Previously published Beta/RC tags and assets remain unchanged.

en.title: Validation and limits
items: Full local regression, focused actual SDK tests, 22 controlled upgrade rows, both CI platforms and source native windows have separate evidence. Live GitHub metadata checks do not establish package downloads or installation; actual signed-client checks are recorded separately.
A strict complex write task still exposed missing executed-command descriptors in its Evidence snapshot. That failure remains rejected; overall readiness is not claimed.

Interactive Windows/Linux installation, physical phones, production OIDC/remote deployments and seven-day use require their corresponding environments. A future RC automatic download and installation has not occurred and is not claimed.

Remote input remains text only with the computer online and approvals local. Isolated writes require Git and external side effects require authorization. Objective token hard limits remain rejected. Uploaded avatars are static; default SVG avatars animate by state.
